name: lumora-kanban
description: Minimalist, distraction-free desktop Kanban client with live DDP sync

scripts.dev:desktop: node scripts/patch-electron-dev.cjs && npm run build:electron && concurrently -k -s first "npm run dev" "node scripts/wait-and-electron.cjs"
scripts.pack: npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --dir --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --linux --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.bun:dev:desktop: bun run build:electron && concurrently -k -s first "bun run dev" "node scripts/wait-and-electron.cjs"
